units.source_text: 夏回山脊上飘浮着摆出一副庄严架势的云彩，好像亡父人检时映入正在诵经的我的眼角时一样。

en.t: Above the ridge of Natsumeguri Mountain floated clouds that had assumed a solemn posture, just as they had entered the corner of my eye while I was chanting sutras at my late father's postmortem examination.

units.source_text: 它充满积郁的光，俯视着这纤细的建筑物。

en.t: They were filled with a pent-up light and looked down upon this delicate building.

units.source_text: 在如此强烈的晚夏的阳光照耀下，金阁仿佛丧失了它的细部的意趣，

en.t: Under such intense late-summer sunlight, the Golden Pavilion seemed to have lost the charm of its details,

units.source_text: 其内部依然笼在阴森冰冷的黑暗中，

en.t: while its interior still remained enclosed in a gloomy, ice-cold darkness,

units.source_text: 只用它自己神秘的轮廓拒绝着周围闪烁的世界。

en.t: rejecting the glittering world around it only with its own mysterious outline.

units.source_text: 并且，只有立在屋顶尖上的凤凰为了不在这太阳之下失足，

en.t: And only the phoenix standing on the tip of the roof, so as not to lose its footing beneath this sun,

units.source_text: 张开尖利的爪子，紧紧地抓住了座子。

en.t: spread its sharp claws and gripped the pedestal tightly.
